properties.description: For each fact held in more than one place (edge and pointer twins, mirrored surfaces, a quantity stated twice), reports which copies disagree and, for numbers, by how much — a sheaf Laplacian with identity maps, i.e. a sum of squared differences over the links that should agree — per fact and per part, with the copies behind each score. A reading, never a repair.
properties.name: Disagreement between the copies of one fact is scored and located, edge by edge
